themes.title: Tech futures slide ahead of Nvidia
themes.summary: Nasdaq futures fell about 1% early Monday while Dow futures were flat; Nvidia was down about 2.2% premarket, and Intel, AMD, Broadcom and Micron fell 3.5% to 5%, with neocloud and server stocks also lower (Reuters via Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Nvidia leadership questions
themes.summary: Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a successor after Jensen Huang stepped down; the Financial Times reported Monday that Huang is considering a return (Reuters via Yahoo Finance; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: December hike fully priced
themes.summary: Markets fully price a Fed rate hike in December, with about an 8% chance of a half-point move per CME FedWatch; the 2-year yield eased Monday after its largest weekly rise in more than two years, and the 10-year yield was about 5.15% (Reuters via Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Warsh speaks today
themes.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh moderates a panel in San Francisco on Monday focused on AI, productivity and the labor market; he has generally avoided explicit rate guidance, and hawkish remarks from Governor Christopher Waller last week raised bets on a larger hike (Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Oil caught between surplus and Gulf tensions
themes.summary: Oil has fallen for two weeks as the IEA projects a supply surplus of about 2 million barrels a day this quarter, while a Sunday Iranian strike on a U.S. base in Bahrain and a reported tanker attack kept supply risk in view (Yahoo Finance).

sectors.name: Energy

watch_list.topic: Nvidia earnings and retail sales on Tuesday
watch_list.why: Nvidia reports fiscal third-quarter results after the close Nov. 17, its first since Huang's departure; consensus is about $108.8 billion in revenue and $2.47 a share (Stockopedia). October retail sales and industrial production are also due (Yahoo Finance).
Pricing is expected Wednesday, Nov. 18, at $70 to $78 a share, valuing the company at up to about $1.4 trillion, with Nasdaq trading expected Thursday, Nov. 19 (Stockopedia; Yahoo Finance).

Warsh speaks Monday and minutes from the October Fed meeting come Wednesday (Reuters via Yahoo Finance); the November Empire State manufacturing index is due Monday, expected at 19 versus 25.5 prior (Yahoo Finance).
